title: Mum asks: agent
hook: Mum asked me: what is an AI agent?

beats.say: Mum asks what an AI agent is. Papa wants one.

screen.title: Mum
screen.body: Beta what is AI AGENT?? Papa wants one for the electricity bill

beats.say: A normal AI only talks. An agent can also press the buttons for you.
Like the neighbour's son who pays your bill on his phone. Useful, but watch what he clicks.
I'm an agent! I already paid Papa's bill!

screen.title: Mum
screen.body:
Beta what is AI AGENT?? Papa wants one for the electricity bill

Ok. So it's like Sharma ji's son.
We will not get one.

beats.say: She says it's like Sharma ji's son. So, no.

caption:
